training_coefficients_ready_gate: On the first true result, notify the parent immediately even if prepare is still running.
query_scope: Read-only lightweight status and logtail for handles in handles.json; new handles are included automatically.
stop_condition: All expected units have appeared and passed, or the parent agent explicitly requests stop.
constraints: Do not submit, cancel, or restart jobs.
Do not modify the remote experiment or protocol.
A query failure is inconclusive; retry the same existing handle next interval.
Do not run computation, model loading, heavy I/O, downloads, transfers, or hashes on a login node.
